claim: The universe is governed by a law of duality, of opposing forces, everywhere and in everything: opposite the light is dark.
Opposing forces don't cancel each other out but balance each other out, within us and our lives too.
We have a drive, a power that wants to carry us towards our dreams and who we're supposed to be.
Opposite the good inside you, that drive towards your dreams, is an opposing force, resistance, as it's called here.
Resistance is not other people, not anything in your physical world: it lives inside you, living and breathing every day as much as you are.

Resistance's one purpose is to push back: to hold you back from where you want to go and who you want to be, to make you stop instead of putting in the effort, to keep you quiet when you should speak up in a relationship.
Resistance will be with you every day, in every aspect of your life.
You cannot kill resistance: resistance never dies.

Resistance seems to show up in every single aspect of life, so beating it is not about those individual aspects but about stepping back and changing, evaluating and strengthening who you are as a man from the inside out.
Get stronger in all the ways resistance can't handle, so you face it every day from strength, as "this big, confident, badass", and it comes cowering.
You probably have areas, as is personally the case too, where you're "really kicking his ass" against resistance, and others where it hands you yours.
The more areas you beat resistance in, the more it gets the message, and the easier it gets.
The podcast is about one thing: unleashing your true power by strengthening the man you are, so you battle resistance everywhere from strength.
Beating resistance seems to come down to a few things: physical well-being, hormones, fasting, sexual energy and the mind.
Physical well-being is absolutely critical: your body affects your mind, emotions, relationships and success in business.
You can't attack resistance from your greatest strength without taking care of your body, and that starts with fitness, nutrition, the right supplements and optimizing your hormones.
When resistance beats you physically, it's like the first battle of the day is already lost, and you go into every other one weaker.

Hormones are super important. As they say, "hormones affect everything and everything affects your hormones", and it's so true: how you feel, perceive, act and think, your confidence, your mental and physical well-being.
name: Hormones in general

claim: Optimizing your hormones and your testosterone, an ongoing topic, puts you in the strongest position to beat resistance and get what you desire.
name: Hormones in general

claim: Fasting, not a daily topic, is such a powerful tool against resistance, like turning on a "temporary superpower against resistance".
Sexual energy, or sex power, is not just critical in your sex life: it affects your life force energy, drive, confidence, physical energy, joy and happiness, every part of you.
Built over time, sexual energy carries you to incredible places.
Single, married or divorced, there are always ways to harness sexual energy.
You can waste sexual energy, which drains you physically, of life force energy and against resistance.
At the fundamental level sexual energy seems to impact literally how strong you are against resistance: the more you build it, the stronger you are, so managing it is amazingly important.
The mind: however strong your body and sexual power, if you don't understand your mind and aren't willing to work with it positively, none of the rest matters.

Working with your mind doesn't take a lot: attitude and mindset, working out in a way that builds the mind's strength for tough situations, and a willingness to sit still and meditate for a few minutes.
None of beating resistance is honestly complicated, but that doesn't mean it's easy.
Get after each area of beating resistance every day.
Stop comparing your body, business or relationships to anybody else's.
Focus on being better today than yesterday.
Being better today than yesterday is, personally, the whole aim and the podcast's goal for you.
We're not wolves, we're human beings. Being an alpha male is not about dominating other people but about dominating resistance within you.
